description: Funding-extreme unwind. Fade crowded positioning when funding >95th %ile + OI still rising.
falsification_criteria: Sharpe < 0.5 over 200+ trades, or edge disappears after funding < 80th %ile.

description: OI-confirmed breakout. Range breakouts only in price↑/OI↑ quadrant (new money).
falsification_criteria: Win rate < 45% or PF < 1.2 in quadrant 1 only.

description: Cascade exhaustion. After liquidation cascade, first retrace tradeable opposite direction.
falsification_criteria: No significant return anomaly in the 30min following cascade events (p > 0.10).

description: Settlement-hour drift. Directional drift around hourly funding settlement boundary.
falsification_criteria: Median return in settlement window not significantly different from non-settlement windows (p > 0.05).

description: Cross-sectional perp momentum. Long top-decile / short bottom-decile 7-day return with funding filter.
falsification_criteria: Long-short spread not significantly > 0 after costs across 3 consecutive rolling windows.

description: BTC-beta residual reversion. Alt residual against BTC-beta-implied price, reverts when >2σ.
falsification_criteria: PF < 1.1 after accounting for two-leg round-trip costs.

description: Asia-range / EU-continuation. Asia range break, EU-confirmed, carried through US open.
falsification_criteria: Session-conditional PF < 1.0 when EU confirmation missing.

description: Oracle-mark dislocation. Mark vs CEX-weighted-median oracle divergence snap-back.
falsification_criteria: Dislocation magnitude insufficient to cover fees at 90th percentile size.

description: Volatility compression expansion. ATR-percentile <20th into directional expansion on structural break.
falsification_criteria: False breakout rate > 60% or post-expansion drift < 1.5x ATR.

description: New-listing drift. Newly listed perps, persistent funding skew + directional drift.
falsification_criteria: Drift not significantly different from zero for listings after 2026-Q1 (p > 0.05).
